prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” HVAC company in Houston — the right choice depends on your location, budget, system brand/age, and whether you need emergency service or a long-term maintenance plan. That said, you can quickly find a high-quality provider by checking a few key things and getting multiple quotes.

What to look for
- Valid Texas HVAC license/registration (check with the Texas Dept. of Licensing & Regulation).  
- Insurance (liability and workers’ comp).  
- NATE-certified technicians and/or manufacturer certification for your AC brand (Trane, Carrier, etc.).  
- Clear, written estimates (diagnostic fee, parts, labor, warranties).  
- Good recent reviews (Google, Yelp) and a solid Better Business Bureau record.  
- Service guarantees, labor and parts warranties, and available financing if needed.  
- Availability of emergency/same‑day service if that’s important to you.

Well-known Houston-area companies (examples to consider)
- John Moore Services — long-established local company, broad service offerings.  
- Abacus Plumbing, AC & Electrical — known in Houston metro for prompt service and maintenance plans.  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (local franchise) — big national network with local technicians.  
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning / On Time Heating & Air — franchise companies that advertise guaranteed appointment windows.  
- Champion (local HVAC contractors with residential focus) — often recommended for installs and repairs.

(These are examples — you should still verify licence/insurance and read recent reviews.)

Quick tips for an emergency (AC not cooling right now)
- Turn the thermostat to “fan on” to circulate air; set temp a bit higher to reduce system strain.  
- If there’s any burning smell or smoke, turn off the system and power at the breaker and call for immediate help.  
- Note the unit’s make/model and any recent service history — that speeds up diagnostics.

If you want, I can:
- Find the top 3 highly rated AC repair companies near your ZIP code, with phone numbers, ratings, and pros/cons; or  
- Draft a short list of questions to ask when you call for an estimate.

Tell me your ZIP code and whether this is residential or commercial (and if it’s an emergency), and I’ll pull tailored recommendations.
